quest.title: Bough Keeper: Dainsleif
quest.description: Katheryne of the Mondstadt Adventurers' Guild seems to have something to tell you.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x800, Primogem x60, Mora x38100, Guide to Freedom x1, Guide to Resistance x1, Guide to Ballad x1, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x7

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Traveler, please, over here.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: It has been a while since you joined the Adventurers' Guild. Are your adventures going smoothly?

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Hmm... is that so? Apart from your own skills, reliable teammates are also indispensable when adventuring.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Another person to count on is always good, after all. But recruiting such dependable companions is no easy matter, is it?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yup, and it's even harder to get a guide as good as Paimon.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Ah, yes, I do have some information that may be of help to you...

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Let me consult our records... Ah, there it is. There's been a certain blond stranger who arrived in Mondstadt lately, dressed in most unusual clothes.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Blond... dresses all funny... It feels like Paimon's heard this one before...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: W—Wait — do you mean...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Could it be...?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Does that stranger's face look... anything like {M#his}{F#hers}!?

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Hmm? Like the Honorary Knight's? No, they couldn't look more different. This stranger is a very tall man, and even has an eyepatch...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So, just some distant relative of Kaeya's, then...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Seriously? How does this have anything to do with Kaeya? Eyepatches can't prove that you're related, anyway!

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: That stranger declined the Guild's invitation, so I can't say that I know anything about the relationship between him and Mr. Kaeya.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Nonetheless, you can look for him if you're interested. Perhaps he might accept your commission instead.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: After all, it is not uncommon for some adventurers to not want to be limited by the Guild, but be happy to accept a fellow adventurer's requests.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: And should this stranger be a strong adventurer indeed, he would certainly be a big help on your journey.

choices.text: But if he's already rejected the Guild...

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Please, don't talk down on yourself like that. You are the Honorary Knight of the Knights of Favonius, after all.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Your deeds are the stuff of song for all the bards in the city even now.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Well, alright then. About that stranger...

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Well, as to further news about him... You may want to ask Mr. Lawrence.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: He stands guard at the city gate, so he may know something about that stranger.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: I wish you every success, adventurer.

dialogues.speaker: Lawrence
dialogues.text: Ah, Honorary Knight. Is something the matter?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, I'm looking for a stranger with an eyepatch...

dialogues.speaker: Lawrence
dialogues.text: A stranger with an eyepatch? Hmm... let me think. Oh yeah. I remember seeing someone like that. A blond stranger dressed in unusual garb.

dialogues.speaker: Lawrence
dialogues.text: He was wandering all over Mondstadt at first, which I found rather suspicious, so I decided to keep an eye on him for a while.

dialogues.speaker: Lawrence
dialogues.text: I lost him pretty quickly... Still, I didn't think that this was such a huge matter that we needed our Outrider to pursue him by air.

dialogues.speaker: Lawrence
dialogues.text: As long as Master Jean is here, there's nothing to fear from some suspicious, unusual-looking person.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That might be true, but if it were up to Jean, she'd take this way more seriously.

dialogues.speaker: Lawrence
dialogues.text: Haha, that is true. But on the other hand, knowing that Master Jean may overreact to the situation is all the more reason to not tell her, no?

dialogues.speaker: Lawrence
dialogues.text: Anyways... Oh, yeah! He was at Wagner's smithy for a while before I tried tailin' him. He might have said something to Wagner.

dialogues.speaker: Lawrence
dialogues.text: You should go ask him. Maybe he has more news about our stranger.

dialogues.speaker: Wagner
dialogues.text: What? You need something?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, I'm looking for a stranger with an eyepatch...

dialogues.speaker: Wagner
dialogues.text: I remember him. He showed up a few days ago, asking to buy a bunch of forging materials.

dialogues.speaker: Wagner
dialogues.text: Can't say I've heard of any of the materials he mentioned, though.

dialogues.speaker: Wagner
dialogues.text: He then had a look at the weapons in my shop before leaving. I've heard that he can be found drinking at the Angel's Share.

dialogues.speaker: Wagner
dialogues.text: If the Knights or the Guild want to get a hold of him, that's the only place to be, haha.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The Angel's Share? Well, Master Diluc probably has his eye on that stranger too, then.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Anyway, let's go to the Angel's Share and have a look.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: What will it be, grape juice or apple cider?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Another day, another lack of alcoholic options...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey Charles, have you seen a blond stranger who wears an eyepatch around here by any chance?

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: That I have. He comes here every night — just to drink, though. Doesn't order anything else.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: He even sometimes mixes his own drinks after he orders them.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: I don't know anything else about him, but from his selections and mixes, I'd say that he's quite the connoisseur.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And what's Master Diluc's opinion?

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: Why, I just gave it to you — "quite the connoisseur."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Investigating everything as always — guess that's Diluc for you...

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: If you're looking for that gentleman, he ordered some new bottle of wine in advance yesterday, so he should be here today, too.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: There's too many raucous patrons on the first floor, so if you want to wait, best to go to the second.

talks.objective: Go to the second floor of the tavern and wait on the seat by the railing

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hi, I'm an adventurer with the Adventurers' Guild.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you do? I'm an Honorary Knight of Favonius...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, he's got no intention of paying us any mind, huh...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, uh, I'm a traveler...
A traveler... you say? Hmph. Why are you traveling?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm looking for my lost relative.
Well, that's as good a reason as any... Sit down over there, then.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So... guess we've broken the ice... What a weird guy.
Hmm. That little one beside you...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's not true, and you know it!
It's indeed a good thing to have someone accompany you on your travels.

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: My name's Dainsleif. I suppose you have some business with me?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Well, I was hoping to invite you to adventure with us...

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: Sure.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: ...Huh?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (And he was so cold just a moment before... Paimon's got a baaaad feeling about this!)

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: But I will require advance payment.

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: 500 Mora, and three answered questions.

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: The 500 is a one-time fee, and we'll settle the questions in a moment.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That's... it?

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: That's it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, now Paimon's got a really bad feeling. That kind of compensation can't be right...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Well, here's the 500 Mora...

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: Ah, thank you. Now, as for my questions, I'd like you to answer them here and now...

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: The answer to a question says nothing about right and wrong. Only about differences in attitude.

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: I only wish to know what your choices are. You need only answer.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Well, alright then.

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: Question one.

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: The crisis Mondstadt faced was resolved by an alliance between yourself and that... Anemo Archon who calls himself Venti. Who, in your view, was the key to ending that crisis?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: How did you know that Venti is...!?

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: I know everything that I should.

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: Haha... Well...? Answer the question.

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: Is that your answer? Hm... I see.

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: Question number two.

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: Rex Lapis, who has defended Liyue Harbor for millennia on end, used his Gnosis to lay down a Contract to End All Contracts, of which the stipulations are still unknown.

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: Who do you think will defend Liyue Harbor in the future, now that they've lost their deity?

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: So that's your answer... I see.

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: Now for my final question.

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: This world has people who gained Visions, and those who did not.

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: Which of the two do you think hold more importance in the eyes of the gods?

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: So... this is your answer, then... I understand.

choices.text: The unity of Mondstadt's people gave us the victory.
Do I need to answer them all correctly?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh-huh, we're the best of friends!

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: Ah, welcome, sir. The wine that you previously ordered is here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He's really here!? Let's go downstairs and have a look.

talks.objective: Go to the first floor of the tavern and find the stranger

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: #As I thought... you really are similar to {M#her}{F#him}.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: #What do you mean, "{M#her}{F#him}"?

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: I'll take that 500 Mora... and now I also understand your views on this world. As we agreed, you may now commission me.

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: That said, I only take commissions related to the Abyss Order.

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: Like you, I am currently on a journey. You intend to find your sibling, while I wish to oppose the Abyss.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, I have met some Abyss Mages in the past...

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: Ugh... Those creatures that serve the Abyss are the fangs and claws by which the Order spreads chaos in this world.

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: I have come to Mondstadt this time while on the trail of an Abyss Herald...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: An Abyss Herald?

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: An even more twisted Abyssal being, one that commands the Abyss Mages.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Come to think of it, since the Stormterror incident ended, we haven't...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, that's right! We've just been fighting against the Fatui in Liyue, who are human too...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We haven't encountered the non-human Abyss Order at all.

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: There's some reason behind that, I'm afraid.

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: It's possible that they may have been under orders to avoid your path.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That does sound pretty dangerous... Maybe they're looking for a better time to ambush us or something...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh-huh! We're super-duper strong!

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: #(That manner... it's just like {M#hers}{F#his}.)

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: Well then, let's go see for ourselves, shall we? According to the leads I have on hand, the Abyss Order has re-infiltrated the Temple of the Falcon.

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: Let's meet up at the temple. Perhaps your questions about the Abyss will be answered there.

talks.objective: Go to the Temple of the Falcon

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: This abandoned temple does bear some marks of the Abyss.

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: The Falcon of the West... though it can soar in the wind, it ultimately does naught but hover under the light of the gods...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you talking about?

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: Mm? Oh, it's nothing. Let's head inside.

talks.objective: Enter the Temple of the Falcon

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: Have you finished searching?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We found lots of signs of the Abyss Order...

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: I searched around these parts and found some signs myself.

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: But they were left behind by Abyss Mages, and there was no deeper Abyssal power to them.

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: It seems that even an Abyss Herald would not wish to make trouble with the Wolf King of the North.

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: We should leave as well. If there's anything praiseworthy about that old wolf, it's his territorial nature.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But now we're out of leads. Are we going to have to give up?

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: No, there is one more place we can go.

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: Let's get a move on, then. I'll wait for you at Stormterror's Lair.

dialogues.speaker: Lawrence
dialogues.text: Huh... I wonder what trouble this stranger brings with him...

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: Just a few Abyss Mages? Seems like that Herald might have already left.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Could you tell me more about the Abyss Order?

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: The Abyss...

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: It is chaos, and it is also destruction. It is a morass of inconceivable madness that encroaches upon this world's very foundations.

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: That... is why even the Dragon of the East, a servant of a deity, was unable to resist its corrosive powers.

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: And the creatures of the Abyss desire nothing less than the overthrow of a world ruled by the archons.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You seem to know a lot about the Abyss, Dain.

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: Haha, well, we do have... some history.

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: I suppose that's as far as chit-chat goes. We should head to Wolvendom.

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: Judging by the traces I'm following, their next appearance may be within the territory of that old wolf.

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: Perhaps we may find our Abyss Herald there.

talks.objective: Leave the Temple of the Falcon

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So in the end, we still couldn't find that Abyss Herald. Bummer.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It is quite a shame.

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: I wouldn't call not having to gaze upon such a creature a "shame," exactly. Still, I do believe that you will come across one eventually.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: N—No... You're right. If it's a really powerful monster, it would be best to go around it...

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: *sigh* How good it would be if all perils one encounters in their journeys could simply be solved by going around them.

choices.text: You seem to be familiar with journeys.

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: Once upon a time, yes... I simply have experience from adventuring together with that traveling companion.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, you know, Dain, you keep talking about that person this, and that person that...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Where are they now, anyway?

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: #{M#She}{F#He}... *sigh*

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: No longer travels.

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: I'm afraid that traveling can be... too exhausting at times.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, is that how it is... Well, why are you traveling alone, then?

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: I... still have some things left unfinished. Once they are done, I too will return home to rest.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yup, and it's good to have a home to come back to, isn't it? We camp out a lot when we travel.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Hey {NICKNAME}, once you find your sibling, we should find a place to stay too, shouldn't we?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... Mondstadt's Fisherman's Toast is pretty tasty, but Liyue's Wanmin Restaurant is great too...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh, either way, we should settle down in a place where there's good food!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Getting a bit ahead of ourselves, I think...

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: Home...

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: Well, it won't be too late to think about where you stay once your journey reaches its end.

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: While you're still traveling, you should...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: ...I sense something familiar. On that cliff.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh? What's familiar?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I felt it for a moment the previous time we came here, too...

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: A familiar feeling, you say? It could be someone you know well, or perhaps a monster.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Could it be... the Abyss?

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: Whichever it is, we should see it for ourselves, and thus see clearly.

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: We can reach the top of that cliff from over there. Let's go.

dialogues.speaker: Wagner
dialogues.text: Do those forging materials even exist...

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: Lord of Wolvendom, Great Wolf King of the North...

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: Sharp of fang and keen of claw, and yet dwelling here only...

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: No, nor does it know me.

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: I only know these things because a previous traveling companion of mine once wanted to hear its story.

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: Alright, let's go see if that Abyss Herald has stopped by here.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But where do we begin? ...Hmm, are you standing here because of these strange bonfires, Dain?

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: Indeed. See that, floating above the flames? It's an Abyssal spell.

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: Knowing what I do of the Order's habits, they've probably left similar marks behind elsewhere. Let's have a look nearby.

talks.objective: Look for clues related to the Abyss Order in Wolvendom

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: That customer will most likely be here tonight. You can wait on the second floor until he arrives.

talks.objective: Look for clues related to the Abyss Order in Wolvendom

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: So, their reach extends here, too... Let's have a closer look.

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: I've heard about what happened to you during Mondstadt's crisis. When you came, this place was known as Stormterror's Lair.

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: But I suppose that this place is more "lair" than "Stormterror" at this point.

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: In fact, if my memory serves, this ruin has had largely nothing to do with that dragon for a long time.

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: The first time I laid eyes upon the ruins of Old Mondstadt, the Dragon of the East had yet to fall, much less come to nest in this place.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? But Paimon remembers that Dvalin first got in trouble hundreds of years ago...

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: Don't think too much about it.

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: Do you remember the Light Actuators that once sealed this ruin?

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: If the Abyss Order is interested in this location, then they will not neglect those mechanisms.

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: Let's go see what the situation is at those Light Actuators.

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: Can you still sense that familiar feeling that you spoke of earlier?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's nearby.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But... it doesn't feel like there's anything around here. No monsters, no people, nothing.

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: Indeed, there doesn't seem to be anything strange about this place. It doesn't look any different from the last time I was here...

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: My traveling companion brought me here on our previous journey.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, Dain, what about you? What's your favorite place?

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: Me? I... no longer remember.

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: I merely followed my traveling companion around on that journey. That's all there was to it.

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: ...Hmm?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's gotten into you? You were just spacing out!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Eh? You mean your {M#sister}{F#brother}?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But, how could that be... You only touched that dandelion for a second!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Yes, the moment I touched it...

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: Perhaps that dandelion bears some sort of "scent" that only you recognize.

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: As for why... has it perhaps experienced something related to you?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, you're saying some real confusing stuff. Paimon doesn't get it at all...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Regardless, I have to get to the bottom of th—!

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: Do not rush.

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: Vexation and anxiety are the enemy of rational thought. Your journey has only just begun, has it not?

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: #At least you now know that {M#she}{F#he} is still on this world.

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: #At this time, the most important thing is the journey to find {M#her}{F#him} itself.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: #And I will find {M#her}{F#him}.

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: Yes, and this is something you must keep in mind as the meaning behind your journey.

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: May you find your kin at the end of that journey. Well then, let us part ways here for now.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh? You're leaving? Already?

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: Only for now. Don't worry, we will meet again.

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: After all... I did take 500 Mora... and those three answers you gave me.

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: #It seems that you're different from {M#her}{F#him}...
